issueCommentThread.body: Sequencing note: this lands first and narrow. The named location for the Shell half is `packages/core/src/hooks/shell-write-targets.ts`: `isInRepoShellWritePath` rejects out-of-tree dests before any basename check, so a kill-switch plant outside the tree fail-opens; the protected-basename predicate must run ahead of it. The general `protected` target class and the out-of-tree floor are #6138; the deny wording contract is #6139. The deny only holds while the hook runs, so #5836 recovery stays a physical dest install, as the body already says.

## Plain-language summary
Outside UAT, agents can still plant the kill-switch with Write/Edit or Shell because the self-serve ban is UAT-gated and Shell can skip out-of-tree dests before a basename check. Prefer-A is an always-on deny for those plants without a human-origin grant, with Shell basename ahead of the in-repo skip.

## Findings

### blocks-the-design: UAT-only settings classification leaves non-UAT Shell plant open
- Evidence: `hasKillSwitchShellWrite` feeds `classifyShellAuthzOps` as `settings` (classify.ts ~4638); docs `## Agent self-serve ban under UAT (#3186)` state the ban only under active UAT. Pin-read at 164fe7adc.
- Failure mode: dogfood/no-UAT agent Shell `New-Item`/`Set-Content`/redirect to `.deft-directive-disable` is not that UAT settings deny.
- Disposition: Prefer-A must make kill-switch plant deny always-on (grant-gated), not UAT-only.

### blocks-the-design: Shell write reissue skips out-of-tree before basename
- Evidence: `decideShellWriteReissue` (`dispatcher.ts` ~2732–2744) continues when `!isInRepoShellWritePath(...)` before injecting dest into `inspectMutationGates`. Sequencing note 6745045821 names basename-ahead-of-`isInRepoShellWritePath` in `shell-write-targets.ts`.
- Failure mode: out-of-tree / alias plant of kill-switch basename can skip the Write-path reissue gate.
- Disposition: protected-basename check must run before the in-repo continue; keep general out-of-tree floor on #6138.

### sharpens-framing: Write/Edit plant is the other half of P1
- Evidence: issue Expected names host Write/Edit; kill-switch docs and Shell classify cover Shell under UAT; declarative Write path is separate from `hasKillSwitchShellWrite`.
- Failure mode: fixing Shell alone leaves Edit/Write plant.
- Disposition: Bound limb for Write/Edit basename deny without human-origin grant.

### footnote: #6139 deny wording and #5836 dest recovery stay keep-outs
- Adjacent classes; do not widen this Bound into general protected-target wording or SEC-WT install recovery.

## Bound remedy
- Always-on Write/Edit deny for `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive` without human-origin grant — relieves: P1
- Shell protected-basename check before `isInRepoShellWritePath` skip in write reissue / shell-write-targets — relieves: P2
- Docs: agent self-serve ban is always-on (grant-gated), not UAT-only — relieves: P3
